title: Sloth eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- branch -->
  <rect x='5' y='70' width='90' height='9' rx='4' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <rect x='5' y='70' width='90' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#A9713A'/>
  <!-- sloth body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='22' ry='16' fill='#9C7B4F'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='15' ry='10' fill='#C4A574'/>
  <!-- arm left holding branch -->
  <path d='M32 60 Q26 68 30 74' stroke='#8A6A42' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- arm right holding snack -->
  <path d='M66 55 Q74 52 76 46' stroke='#8A6A42' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- legs hanging -->
  <path d='M40 72 Q38 80 40 84' stroke='#8A6A42' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 72 Q62 80 60 84' stroke='#8A6A42' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='17' fill='#B08D5B'/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='12' ry='10' fill='#E8D5A8'/>
  <!-- eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='33' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='#5A4A33'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='33' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='#5A4A33'/>
  <circle cx='44.5' cy='32.5' r='1.8' fill='#FFF6D8'/>
  <circle cx='56.5' cy='32.5' r='1.8' fill='#FFF6D8'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='3' ry='2.2' fill='#3D3020'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 43 Q50 47 55 43' stroke='#7A6448' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- snack: cookie -->
  <circle cx='80' cy='40' r='8' fill='#D89A4E'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='40' r='8' fill='none' stroke='#B87A32' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='77' cy='38' r='1.4' fill='#5C3A1E'/>
  <circle cx='83' cy='39' r='1.4' fill='#5C3A1E'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='43' r='1.4' fill='#5C3A1E'/>
  <circle cx='77' cy='43' r='1.2' fill='#5C3A1E'/>
  <!-- bite mark -->
  <circle cx='86' cy='36' r='3' fill='#D89A4E'/>
  <!-- crumbs -->
  <circle cx='74' cy='48' r='1.2' fill='#E8B060'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='44' r='1' fill='#E8B060'/>
  <!-- branch leaves -->
  <ellipse cx='14' cy='66' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#4CA64C' transform='rotate(-25 14 66)'/>
  <ellipse cx='86' cy='66' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#4CA64C' transform='rotate(25 86 66)'/>
</svg>
